Hi again! I’m Taylor.

I’m a security engineer based in the San Francisco Bay Area. I work at LinkedIn. During my career, I have had the opportunity to work with amazing people securing supply chains, automating processes, and leading technical teams.

This is my digital garden—a space where I collect thoughts, projects, and my personal interests in the realm of cybersecurity. I publish articles and notes documenting ideas and learnings along the way.

I’m constantly working on personal projects. My journey includes writing documentation, creating requirements for my professional projects, and occasionally mentoring. See my resume for more details.

You can find me on LinkedIn (of course) as Taylor Scott, or email me at contact.taylorzs@gmail.com. I’m considering making a Mastodon account; if I do so, I’ll update this page with the link.
